g.text: Everything already works with no network at all. The log is the source of truth; every other store is a rebuildable projection.

text.tspan: small JSON file · UUIDv7 per tap

g.text: crates/core — the shared brain (never depends on the network or the UI)
(ed25519) signs every event — its public half
(one per baby) seals the payload so a relaying peer cannot read it.
Derived from the log — rebuildable at any time
